purpose: Admit deterministic cloud-path labels derived from immutable provider-native runtime evidence without treating scripts, manuals, or AI output as ground truth.
required_path_properties: external or low-privilege entry is defined by frozen configuration or runtime identity
at least two causal or reachability relationships
every critical relationship has immutable raw references

required: provider-native explicit denial code or decision
same-target success control or independent proof that the target exists
no contrary success by the denied principal in the same state

forbidden_shortcuts: manual or walkthrough used directly as gold
missing finding interpreted as not exposed
credentials obtained interpreted as data read without a data operation
repeated retries counted as independent cases
human_role: Audit a stratified sample of semantic mappings and all source-admission disputes; do not relabel provider allow/deny decisions by intuition.
